items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Octave was a good chord piano player.

ctx.x: And when I came by, I started to see that old group of musicians going out around there, and things had changed so much. Yeah. Oh, Octave used to play in one of the plays with them. Octave was a good chord piano player. Rarely I ever heard him play a solo, and he played with Celestad's band, he played with all those bands, but he was a good rhythm man, but I don't ever remember hearing him play a solo.
Well, maybe that's what made him a good rhythm man. But he played good chords. Yes.
